name: winutil-presets
description:
Dear Team,

For the upcoming workstation rollout we’ll be applying three core preset groups. The **system** preset will turn off telemetry with `disableTelemetry`, speed up boot times by enabling fast startup via `enableFastStartup`, and clean the machines of unnecessary software by executing `removeBloatware`. In the **development** preset we’ll provision the usual tooling: we’ll install version control with `installGit`, set up the runtime environment using `installNodeJS`, and provide our standard editor through `installVSCode`. Finally, the **privacy** preset will enhance user privacy by blocking intrusive ads (`blockAds`), disabling location tracking (`disableLocation`), and automatically clearing the browser history (`clearBrowserHistory`).  

Please review these settings and let me know if any adjustments are needed before we push the configuration to all devices.
